blurb: Maze tanks on a fresh symmetric map every round. Shells ricochet six times, weapon pickups, railguns, homing shells and mines. First to 5 rounds.
keys: Run python3 server.py in 2players/tank-duel/, then open the printed URL on both devices — or hit P2 join to play 2P on one keyboard (P1 WASD+Space, P2 arrows+Enter). · 🎮 pad supported
title: Tank Duel
